# Privacy corpus for TestTemplatePrivacy (AC-002). See README.md for the format.
# Every record carries at least one marker: 'SECRET-1', 424242, user=SECRET-2,
# "SECRET-3" (classes 22 and 23, and after a "for type" phrase), or an e-mail
# address in a statement, written {email}.
